description: Readwise connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's saved book/article highlights as `readwise:highlight` items in the local index — the highlighted excerpt text, the user's note, the parent book/article id, the location + location type, the color, tags, and the source article URL (for web highlights) — plus their parent books/articles as `readwise:book` items (title, author, category, source, highlight count, document note, tags, ASIN, source + Readwise book-review URLs), so a highlight's `book_id` resolves to a real indexed record. Useful for answering reading questions ("what did I highlight about retries?", "which book was that note in?") without leaving Nimbus. Token API-token auth (`Authorization: Token <token>` — Django-REST-Framework token auth, NOT Bearer). The SaaS host (readwise.io) is fixed. Readwise paginates both `/api/v2/highlights/` and `/api/v2/books/` by page number (DRF `{ count, next, previous, results }` envelope, page_size=1000). `highlighted_at` / `last_highlight_at` / `updated` are ISO-8601 (converted to epoch-ms on index). Book `external_id`s are namespaced `book/<id>` because Readwise numbers books and highlights in separate sequences. Documents / daily-review and the Reader v3 API remain deferred follow-ups.
author: Nimbus
